# Care Package Singapore

> > Care Package Singapore is a one-stop shop specializing in corporate gift hampers, care packs, and bulk-order wellness products with extensive halal-certified options.

The site offers curated care packages and individual gift items including immunity packs, healthy snacks, drinkware, electronics, and festive goodies. Products feature brands like G3Tech, NutriOne, OTO, KRAKAKOA, and Brands, with minimum order quantities typically ranging from 50-100 units for corporate gifting.

## Key Topics

- Corporate gift hampers
- Halal-certified products
- Bulk order care packages
- G3Tech Hand Sanitizer & Disinfectant
- Immunity and wellness packs
- Healthy snacks (NutriOne, SKINNIE Biscotti, Noi)
- OTO wellness devices
- Festive goodies and seasonal gifts
- 304 stainless steel drinkware
- Sustainable office essentials
- THERMOS products
- New Zealand imports (Manuka honey, Neat Feat)
- Singapore-based corporate gifting
- MOQ 50-100 units
- Door-to-door delivery services
